Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0459705
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP/S4170003485
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
It seems that the modbus communication for BC4 is not ok. Please check on site this cable and if the modbus address is correct:
You can try swapping the BC4 with BC3 for example and see if the error persists. If the error persists, please replace the BC4.
If the error is now on the previous BC3, then please check the cables again and see if there is any issue. You have my recommendation to take spare BC4 to site.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,

Francisco de Matos Joaquim
